title: Fix orthographic position reconstruction and reflections in GI
body:
The shared GI pass reconstructs mirrored X/Y positions for single-view orthographic cameras and uses perspective-style viewing directions for their reflections.

Use the existing inverse-projection path and parallel viewing directions for orthographic cameras. Together, these changes remove the reported VoxelGI shadow artifact and SDFGI lighting bands in the supplied reproduction projects.

Fixes #69784.
Fixes #60522.

## Validation

Built unmodified and patched Windows editors from `57277407e77e61b161f35dbd7aeb510f7a9e26a6` and compared them on an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT using Vulkan Forward+, at 800 × 600.

- Both original reproductions checked at full and half GI resolution, including camera rotation and translation.
- VoxelGI: the orange shadow line is removed at the tested animation positions (0, 2.5, and 5 seconds).
- SDFGI: the horizontal bands are removed and remain absent after 30 additional seconds of stationary rendering at full GI resolution.
- No visible regressions in perspective, asymmetric-frustum, or synthetic two-view SDFGI captures.
- Both builds succeeded; C++/GLSL formatting and `git diff --check` passed.

VoxelGI stereo validation was blocked by the same 2D/2DArray texture-binding error in both builds. Stereo tests used synthetic GPU views, without a headset.

AI was used to generate the patches.
